messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — config-monitor flagged an S3 ACL change making bucket "redwood-customer-exports" publicly listable. Saw a spike in unauthenticated GETs.
Megan Ortiz: Confirming. Ran `aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-customer-exports` -> Grants show `URI: http://acs.amazonaws.com/groups/global/AllUsers` :grimacing:
Alex Chen: Who updated the ACL?
security-bot: Detected PutBucketAcl event by user arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/deploy-bot at 2026-11-03T15:02:11Z. Source IP 52.47.12.34. (rule: s3-public-acl-alert)
Megan Ortiz: That's our deploy-bot service account. Possibly a broken deploy step. Megan Ortiz: I'm going to remove public ACL and add explicit deny public bucket policy.
Ian Patel: Also check if any IAM role has a wildcard principal that could be used to directly PUT ACLs.
Megan Ortiz: Executing: `aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-customer-exports --acl private` now.
Megan Ortiz: Adding deny policy: `aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket redwood-customer-exports --policy file://deny-public.json` (policy denies s3:GetObject when `aws:PrincipalArn` is `*`).
Alex Chen: Revoke deploy-bot's inline ACL permissions for now. Megan, can you remove `s3:PutBucketAcl` from that user/role?
Megan Ortiz: Removing inline policy that granted wide ACL perms. `aws iam delete-user-policy --user-name deploy-bot --policy-name allow-s3-acl`
Ian Patel: Rotate deploy-bot's access keys and create temp deny in IAM: `aws iam update-assume-role-policy` to block assume for outside jobs.
Megan Ortiz: Keys rotated. Old keys deactivated.
security-bot: Found 412 unique GET requests from public IPs between 14:55 and 15:05 UTC. No PUTs observed after ACL change reversed.
Alex Chen: Any customer data exfil? What objects were listable/read?
Megan Ortiz: Access logs show only object list and a few small CSV downloads (export_daily.csv, ~120KB). Looks like non-sensitive telemetry exports.
Leah Kim: Tagging legal — Leah Kim here. Please compile timeline and list of affected customers. We may need to notify if PII was involved.
Alex Chen: Will produce timeline. Quick priorities: contain, identify blast radius, rotate creds, enable logging & alerts, customer comms if needed.
Ian Patel: Enabling S3 server access logs + CloudTrail data events for S3 on the bucket. Also turning on bucket-level object lock? (not needed now)
Megan Ortiz: Enabled server access logs to `s3://redwood-audit-logs/` and turned on CloudTrail data events for S3. Also enabled S3 Block Public Access at account level for the time being.
Alex Chen: Good. Next: audit KMS key usage — was the bucket encrypted with a customer-managed key?
Megan Ortiz: Yes, SSE-KMS using alias `alias/redwood-exports-kms`. I checked CloudTrail — no Decrypt calls from outside our org. Keys look fine.
Alex Chen: Great. Still schedule re-encryption plan and explicit regranting of kms:Decrypt only to needed principals.
Leah Kim: Legal wants a short write-up for the incident channel and a decision tree for disclosure. If data is telemetry only, likely not reportable, but need confirmation.
Alex Chen: I'll draft the incident summary.
Ian Patel: For post-incident: 1) RBAC review for deploy-bot & any CI roles, 2) Add CI lint rule preventing s3:PutBucketAcl in deploy roles, 3) Add terraform guardrails (sentinel/OPA), 4) Run org-wide policy scan.
Megan Ortiz: Creating tickets: ENGSEC-324 (containment + rotate), INFRA-710 (CI role hardening), SRE-402 (monitoring/alerts), LEGAL-55 (disclosure assessment).
Alex Chen: Assigning owners: Megan -> containment/cleanup, Ian -> logging & monitoring, Alex -> incident write-up and postmortem coordination, Leah -> legal review.
security-bot: Created incident: INC-20261103-01. Severity: P2.
Megan Ortiz: Quick note — found an old inline policy in terraform state that re-applies `public-read` in one deploy stage. Removing that and adding a test in the pipeline.
Ian Patel: Add a CloudWatch alarm on S3BucketAclChanged events and tie to PagerDuty.
Leah Kim: Once we have the timeline and customer list, I'll advise on disclosure. Keep all notes centralized in the incident doc.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. I'll post a short summary in #incidents after this thread and start a postmortem template. :thumbsup:
Megan Ortiz: Done with the immediate fixes; monitoring for any regressions.
Ian Patel: Logs archived to `s3://redwood-audit-logs/incidents/1812345678/` and preserved.
Alex Chen: Closing containment loop here — will reopen if anything else appears. Follow-ups in the tickets.
